purpose: Generate and validate official MIRACL EvalAI-style Arabic dev/test-a top-100 TREC run files for the best BGE-M3 hybrid r100 retrieval system.
dataset: mteb/MIRACLRetrieval corpus plus official miracl/miracl Arabic topics/qrels

evaluator.method: Full-corpus dense+sparse candidate generation followed by FlagEmbedding BGEM3FlagModel.compute_score dense+sparse+ColBERT reranking.

submission_status.blocker: EvalAI challenge API reported is_active=false and is_frozen=true, so the package was prepared and validated but not uploaded.

interpretation: The official-format Arabic dev/test-a package is ready and validates structurally: ar_dev has 2,896 queries x 100 hits, ar_test-a has 936 queries x 100 hits, and the zip contains the required two files under one top-level directory.
The dev run file recomputes to main_score/nDCG@10 0.801110, effectively matching the prior BGE-M3 hybrid r100 result while using the official TREC run-file output path.
This remains a top-tier BGE-M3 hybrid retrieval-system result, not a newly trained standalone embedding checkpoint or a formal leaderboard rank because EvalAI is currently frozen/inactive.
next_experiment: If an official leaderboard submission route is reopened, upload the validated zip to challenge 1881 phase 3745. For actual model SOTA progress, use this BGE-M3 hybrid run as a teacher for training or distillation rather than continuing dense-only baselines.
